source_batch.unit_label: BRBL C U04: Distinguish Central Registry recording from Tribunal adjudication and statutory appeal

facts.statement: Central Registry records specified transactions. DRT/DRAT are adjudicatory/appellate institutions. Registration does not replace other legal conditions or prove debt discharge; current registry priority/deadline and appeal details require applicable text.

payload.title: A registry entry and a Tribunal order do different work
payload.core_explanation_md:
The Central Registry is part of the statutory transaction-recording framework. DRT is the Tribunal and DRAT the appellate institution identified by the Act. A filed record does not mean the Registrar has adjudicated every dispute about debt, title, validity or priority. Conversely, a Tribunal filing is not a substitute for every required security registration.

When preparing a legal checklist, assign each task to the right system: recording a security transaction, determining a challenge and pursuing an appeal are separate acts. Exact registry timing, priority, remedy periods and deposit rules must use the applicable amended provisions; the historical compilation retained here is not a current procedural checklist.

self_check.prompt_text: Can proof of a registry filing be treated as a final Tribunal determination of the debt?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Recording and adjudication serve different functions.

payload.stem_md: A clerk treats a Central Registry acknowledgement as a final DRT judgment on a disputed debt. Which distinction resolves the error?

options.text_md: Every acknowledgement is a binding judicial decree
options.explanation_md: A transaction record is not automatically a merits adjudication.

options.text_md: DRAT is the name of a registry form
options.explanation_md: DRAT is the appellate institution, not the registry acknowledgement.

options.text_md: Registry recording and Tribunal adjudication are different legal functions
options.explanation_md: The file must identify what the record actually proves.

options.text_md: Once registered, no other statutory condition can apply
options.explanation_md: Registration does not replace every other validity or procedure requirement.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The file must identify what the record actually proves.

payload.stem_md: A process diagram uses DRT and DRAT as interchangeable names. What correction is required?

options.text_md: Separate the Tribunal from the appellate institution and check the relevant remedy provision
options.explanation_md: The institutions have different statutory roles.

options.text_md: Replace both with the Central Registrar because all three are identical
options.explanation_md: The registry and adjudicatory institutions are distinct.

options.text_md: Treat the bank board as the appellate Tribunal
options.explanation_md: Internal corporate governance is not the statutory appellate forum.

options.text_md: Delete every review stage because the loan is secured
options.explanation_md: The existence of security does not remove statutory remedies.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The institutions have different statutory roles.
